scenarios.title: A｜开玩笑提醒
scenarios.setting: 两个人正在吃饭，对方已经连续几次拿起手机。

turns.prompt: 你想用轻松的玩笑提醒对方别一直看手机，会怎么说？

choices.text: Should I text you instead? 😂

feedback.naturalExpression: Should I text you instead? 😂
feedback.explanation: 征求建议或确认下一步，适合流程不熟悉时请对方指导。

choices.text: Wow, your phone is getting more attention than I am tonight.

feedback.naturalExpression: Wow, your phone is getting more attention than I am tonight.
feedback.explanation: 直接交代自己当前的状态或安排，能让对方据此继续交流。

choices.text: Is your phone joining us for dinner too?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is your phone joining us for dinner too?
feedback.explanation: 用疑问句核对刚谈到的状态或条件，给对方确认和更正的机会。

choices.text: I’m starting to get jealous of your phone.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m starting to get jealous of your phone.
feedback.explanation: 直接交代自己当前的状态或安排，能让对方据此继续交流。

choices.text: Why do you always watch your phone?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Should I text you instead? 😂
feedback.explanation: 看手机通常说“look at / check your phone”；“watch”更像持续观看画面。

turns.text: Okay, okay. I’m sorry. I’ll put it away.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thank you. I was starting to feel like the third wheel.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thank you. I was starting to feel like the third wheel.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: Haha, I’m kidding. Mostly.

feedback.naturalExpression: Haha, I’m kidding. Mostly.
feedback.explanation: “mostly”限定为主要情况，说明还有其他可能，而不是一概而论。

choices.text: Good. Now where were we?

feedback.naturalExpression: Good. Now where were we?
feedback.explanation: 用疑问句核对刚谈到的状态或条件，给对方确认和更正的机会。

turns.text: You were telling me about your trip.

turns.prompt: 你想自然接回被打断的话题，会怎么说？

choices.text: Right! So anyway…

feedback.naturalExpression: Right! So anyway…
feedback.explanation: 先回应对方刚给的信息或建议，再接着说明自己的想法，让话题顺着当前内容继续。

choices.text: See? Much better already.

feedback.naturalExpression: See? Much better already.
feedback.explanation: “already”强调事情已经发生或完成，适合核对进度与时间先后。

scenarios.title: B｜直接提出
scenarios.setting: 过了一会儿，对方又开始频繁查看手机。

turns.prompt: 你想请对方暂时放下手机，专心交流，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hey, could you put your phone away for a little while?

feedback.naturalExpression: Hey, could you put your phone away for a little while?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: I don’t mean to be rude, but you’ve been checking your phone a lot.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t mean to be rude, but you’ve been checking your phone a lot.
feedback.explanation: 先交代一部分情况，再补充限制或不同之处，避免对方只根据前半句作判断。

choices.text: Is there something urgent you need to deal with?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there something urgent you need to deal with?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

choices.text: I’m finding it a little hard to have a conversation when you’re on your phone this much.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m finding it a little hard to have a conversation when you’re on your phone this much.
feedback.explanation: “a little”表示少量或轻微程度，适合表达希望只作小幅调整。

turns.prompt: 你想表示理解对方的解释或立场，会怎么说？

choices.text: I understand. If it’s urgent, you can deal with it.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand. If it’s urgent, you can deal with it.
feedback.explanation: “I understand”承认听懂了对方的理由或难处，为继续协商提供基础。

choices.text: That’s fine, but if it can wait, I’d rather we focus on dinner.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s fine, but if it can wait, I’d rather we focus on dinner.
feedback.explanation: 把选择说成自己的偏好，可以表明立场，而不必否定另一种选择。

choices.text: If you need a few minutes to handle work, that’s okay. Just let me know.

feedback.naturalExpression: If you need a few minutes to handle work, that’s okay. Just let me know.
feedback.explanation: 用简短回应表示不介意或愿意体谅，可以减轻对方的歉意。

choices.text: I get it. I just don’t want to spend the whole date competing with your phone.

feedback.naturalExpression: I get it. I just don’t want to spend the whole date competing with your phone.
feedback.explanation: 明确说明哪件事没有发生或无法进行，把问题落在具体动作上。

turns.text: No, you’re right. It can wait.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thanks. I appreciate that.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. I appreciate that.
feedback.explanation: “I appreciate”表达对帮助、坦诚或付出的感谢，后面点明感谢对象更具体。

choices.text: Great. Let’s enjoy the rest of the evening.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Let’s enjoy the rest of the evening.
feedback.explanation: 把安排作为共同商量的建议提出，方便对方接受、调整或补充。

scenarios.title: C｜决定提前离开
scenarios.setting: 对方答应收起手机，但很快又开始刷消息，玩家已经明显失去继续约会的兴趣。

turns.prompt: 关于「约会时对方一直看手机」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Actually, I think I’m going to head home.

feedback.naturalExpression: Actually, I think I’m going to head home.
feedback.explanation: “I’m going to”说明计划或去向，能让对方知道接下来的安排。

choices.text: I don’t think I’m enjoying this very much, so I’m going to call it a night.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t think I’m enjoying this very much, so I’m going to call it a night.
feedback.explanation: “I don’t think”把不同意见表达为自己的判断，而不是直接断定对方错误。

choices.text: I think we should probably end the evening here.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think we should probably end the evening here.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: Honestly, I don’t really want to sit here while you’re on your phone all night.

feedback.naturalExpression: Honestly, I don’t really want to sit here while you’re on your phone all night.
feedback.explanation: 明确说明哪件事没有发生或无法进行，把问题落在具体动作上。

turns.text: Wait, seriously? I’m sorry. I’ll put it away now.

turns.prompt: 你想说明提醒后情况仍未改变，会怎么说？

choices.text: I already brought it up, and nothing really changed.

feedback.naturalExpression: I already brought it up, and nothing really changed.
feedback.explanation: “brought it up”表示提起某个话题，适合说明以前已经沟通过的问题。

choices.text: I appreciate that, but I think I’m ready to leave.

feedback.naturalExpression: I appreciate that, but I think I’m ready to leave.
feedback.explanation: “I appreciate”表达对帮助、坦诚或付出的感谢，后面点明感谢对象更具体。

choices.text: I’m not trying to punish you. I’m just not having a good time anymore.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not trying to punish you. I’m just not having a good time anymore.
feedback.explanation: “not trying to”澄清自己没有某种意图，能在提出疑问前减少对方的防御感。

choices.text: Maybe we can talk another time, but I think I’m done for tonight.

feedback.naturalExpression: Maybe we can talk another time, but I think I’m done for tonight.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

turns.text: I didn’t realize it was bothering you that much.

turns.prompt: 你想强调自己之前已经表达过不舒服，会怎么说？

choices.text: That’s why I mentioned it earlier.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s why I mentioned it earlier.
feedback.explanation: 接着上文说明对象的具体情况，指代清楚时无需重复完整名称。

choices.text: I know. But I don’t want to keep asking for your attention.

feedback.naturalExpression: I know. But I don’t want to keep asking for your attention.
feedback.explanation: “I don’t want to”明确表达自己的意愿或界限，后面的具体动作说明拒绝的是哪件事。

choices.text: It’s okay. I just think it’s better if I head home.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s okay. I just think it’s better if I head home.
feedback.explanation: 用简短回应表示不介意或愿意体谅，可以减轻对方的歉意。

turns.prompt: 你想友好地结束这段交流，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thanks. Good night.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. Good night.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: I appreciate the apology. Take care.

feedback.naturalExpression: I appreciate the apology. Take care.
feedback.explanation: “I appreciate”表达对帮助、坦诚或付出的感谢，后面点明感谢对象更具体。
